title: Explainable machine learning and multimodal single cell analysis link NR4A2 to CD8(+) T-cell terminal exhaustion and a CD8-adjusted prognostic signature in hepatocellular carcinoma.
authors: Faisal, Shah; Sammad, Abdul; Ejaz, Muhammad Adeel; Wang, Zhen-Bo
one_liner_zh: 该文利用多模态单细胞与可解释机器学习分析NR4A2与CD8+T细胞终末耗竭的关联，虽涉及转录因子但未聚焦TF-DNA结合机制，且方法以表达分析为主，缺乏AI/物理模拟的互作建模。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Terminal exhaustion of CD8(+) tumour-infiltrating lymphocytes constrains the benefit of immune-checkpoint blockade in hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC). The orphan nuclear receptor NR4A2 (Nurr1) belongs to a transcription-factor family implicated in murine T-cell exhaustion, yet its behaviour in the human HCC microenvironment has not been characterised across data modalities. We asked whether NR4A2 is specifically coupled to the terminal-exhaustion programme of human HCC CD8(+) T cells, and whether that coupling is reflected in chromatin, tissue topography and bulk-tumour outcome data. METHODS: We reanalysed publicly available human HCC datasets spanning four modalities: single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq; GSE149614, GSE98638, GSE151530, GSE125449), single-cell ATAC sequencing (scATAC-seq; GSE227265), imaging-based spatial transcriptomics (10x Xenium human liver-cancer section) and bulk RNA sequencing with overall-survival annotation (TCGA-LIHC). NR4A2 was profiled across cell compartments and, at higher resolution, across CD8(+) T-cell states defined from curated exhaustion, progenitor, effector and naive gene modules. We tested NR4A2-exhaustion coupling at single-cell and pseudobulk level, examined NR4A2 motif accessibility, traced NR4A2 along a diffusion-pseudotime exhaustion axis, evaluated spatial co-localisation of exhausted CD8(+) T cells with tumour-associated macrophages (TAMs), benchmarked machine-learning classifiers of the exhausted state, and compared the human NR4A2 co-expression direction with the published NR4A1/2-knockout phenotype. We additionally trained interpretable gradient-boosted-tree models with SHAP attribution to characterise the exhausted and NR4A2-high states, scored a NR4A2 co-expression regulon, related the programme to immunotherapy-relevant signatures, and modelled overall survival using a CD8-infiltration-adjusted exhaustion score. RESULTS: NR4A2 was broadly expressed across HCC compartments and was highest in myeloid cells rather than being T-cell restricted; at whole-compartment and bulk-tumour resolution it was not a clean exhaustion marker. At the resolution of CD8(+) T-cell states, however, NR4A2 was sharply enriched in terminally exhausted cells (mean 3.62 versus 1.05; Mann-Whitney p  approximately  3.4 x 10(-83)) and correlated with the exhaustion module (single-cell Spearman rho = 0.45) but not with the effector module (rho = 0.06), arguing that NR4A2 is not a generic activation gene. NR4A2 expression increased monotonically along a diffusion-pseudotime axis toward terminal exhaustion (rho = 0.37). In Xenium tissue, exhausted CD8(+) T cells were modestly but significantly enriched in the neighbourhood of TAMs relative to other CD8(+) T cells (permutation p = 0.005). The human NR4A2 co-expression direction was 83% concordant with the published NR4A1/2-knockout differential-expression direction. In bulk TCGA-LIHC, NR4A2 was lower in tumour than adjacent liver and only weakly exhaustion-correlated, consistent with hepatocyte-dominated bulk signal and reinforcing the need for compartment-resolved analysis. Interpretable machine learning attributed NR4A2-high status to an immediate-early/AP-1 activation programme, a NR4A2 co-expression regulon was selectively active in exhausted cells, and the programme tracked the T-cell-inflamed phenotype (rho = 0.87); although raw bulk NR4A2 was non-prognostic, a CD8-infiltration-adjusted exhaustion score independently predicted shorter overall survival (hazard ratio 1.42 per standard deviation, p < 0.001). CONCLUSIONS: A NR4A2 co-expression regulon was most active in exhausted cells; explainable modelling linked NR4A2-high status to an immediate-early/AP-1 activation programme; the programme marked immune-hot tumours; and although bulk NR4A2 was non-prognostic, a CD8-infiltration-adjusted exhaustion score was independently associated with worse overall survival (HR 1.42 per SD, p < 0.001). Across four independent data modalities, NR4A2 behaves as a resolution-dependent marker of the terminal-exhaustion programme in HCC CD8(+) T cells that is spatially associated with the myeloid niche. The convergence supports NR4A2 as a candidate component of an HCC exhaustion signature and a hypothesis-generating target for functional study, while underscoring that its association is masked in bulk and whole-compartment data.
abstract_zh: 背景：CD8(+)肿瘤浸润淋巴细胞的终末耗竭限制了肝细胞癌（HCC）中免疫检查点阻断的获益。孤儿核受体NR4A2（Nurr1）属于一个与小鼠T细胞耗竭相关的转录因子家族，但其在人类HCC微环境中的行为尚未跨数据模态得到表征。我们探究了NR4A2是否特异性地与人类HCC CD8(+) T细胞的终末耗竭程序偶联，以及这种偶联是否反映在染色质、组织拓扑结构和 bulk 肿瘤结局数据中。方法：我们重新分析了公开可用的人类HCC数据集，涵盖四种模态：单细胞RNA测序（scRNA-seq；GSE149614、GSE98638、GSE151530、GSE125449）、单细胞ATAC测序（scATAC-seq；GSE227265）、基于成像的空间转录组学（10x Xenium 人类肝癌切片）以及带有总生存期注释的 bulk RNA测序（TCGA-LIHC）。我们在细胞区室层面，并在更高分辨率下，对由精选的耗竭、祖细胞、效应和初始基因模块定义的CD8(+) T细胞状态中，对NR4A2进行了分析。我们在单细胞和伪bulk水平测试了NR4A2-耗竭偶联，检查了NR4A2基序可及性，沿扩散伪时间耗竭轴追踪了NR4A2，评估了耗竭CD8(+) T细胞与肿瘤相关巨噬细胞（TAMs）的空间共定位，对耗竭状态的机器学习分类器进行了基准测试，并将人类NR4A2共表达方向与已发表的NR4A1/2敲除表型进行了比较。我们还训练了具有SHAP归因的可解释梯度提升树模型，以表征耗竭和NR4A2高表达状态，评分了NR4A2共表达调节子，将该程序与免疫治疗相关特征联系起来，并使用CD8浸润调整的耗竭评分对总生存期进行了建模。结果：NR4A2在HCC各区室中广泛表达，在髓系细胞中最高，而非局限于T细胞；在整体区室和bulk肿瘤分辨率下，它并非一个干净的耗竭标志物。然而，在CD8(+) T细胞状态的分辨率下，NR4A2在终末耗竭细胞中显著富集（均值3.62对1.05；Mann-Whitney p 约 3.4 x 10(-83)），并与耗竭模块相关（单细胞Spearman rho = 0.45），但与效应模块不相关（rho = 0.06），这表明NR4A2并非一个通用的激活基因。NR4A2表达沿扩散伪时间轴朝向终末耗竭单调增加（rho = 0.37）。在Xenium组织中，相对于其他CD8(+) T细胞，耗竭CD8(+) T细胞在TAMs邻近区域适度但显著富集（置换检验p = 0.005）。人类NR4A2共表达方向与已发表的NR4A1/2敲除差异表达方向有83%的一致性。在bulk TCGA-LIHC中，NR4A2在肿瘤中的表达低于邻近肝脏，且仅与耗竭弱相关，这与肝细胞主导的bulk信号一致，并强调了区室解析分析的必要性。可解释机器学习将NR4A2高表达状态归因于即时早期/AP-1激活程序，NR4A2共表达调节子在耗竭细胞中选择性活跃，且该程序追踪T细胞炎症表型（rho = 0.87）；尽管原始bulk NR4A2无预后价值，但CD8浸润调整的耗竭评分独立预测了较短的总生存期（风险比每标准差1.42，p < 0.001）。结论：NR4A2共表达调节子在耗竭细胞中活性最高；可解释建模将NR4A2高表达状态与即时早期/AP-1激活程序联系起来；该程序标记了免疫热肿瘤；尽管bulk NR4A2无预后价值，但CD8浸润调整的耗竭评分与较差的总生存期独立相关（HR每SD 1.42，p < 0.001）。在四个独立数据模态中，NR4A2表现为HCC CD8(+) T细胞终末耗竭程序的解析度依赖性标志物，并与髓系生态位空间相关。这种收敛性支持NR4A2作为HCC耗竭特征的一个候选组分和功能研究的假设生成靶点，同时强调其关联在bulk和整体区室数据中被掩盖。
